comment.body: Thanks for describing the user Scoop install to D:\PowerToys and repeated D:\Config.Msi rollback-file security prompts. You later mentioned trying the matching setup EXE as administrator, but the outcome is unclear. Could you confirm whether that uninstall completed and whether Settings still produces repeated prompts on a current PowerToys version? This distinguishes elevation/scope from a package-owned rollback failure; please do not remove .rbf files manually.
